about_the_product.description: The Bajaj Majesty Dx-11 is a sleek and efficient dry iron designed for quick and effective ironing. Featuring a durable stainless steel soleplate, it glides smoothly over fabrics, ensuring a wrinkle-free finish. The iron is equipped with a temperature control dial for various fabric types, allowing you to customize the heat settings. Its compact design and lightweight build make it easy to handle, while the blue and white color scheme adds a modern touch to your laundry routine.
